author: MrMelbert

Pepper spray clothing dirt is applied piecemeal - smaller dosages, rather than doing nothing, now build up with repeat applications.

title: [MDB IGNORE] Lavaland Mineral Rework: Yapmining 2026
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Lavaland has received 2 new rock types: Siderite, rich in iron and titanium, and Shale, full of plasma, gold and uranium.
A guaranteed river spawn and a fishing pond have been added to the lavaland outpost raptor area.
Ores now tend to spawn in veins or clusters, and are much more likely to spawn near exposed rock.
Natural ore spawns are much more abundant than before, closer to pre-arcmining levels. Vent output has been halved
PKA AOE mining module has been reverted to 3x3 and incurs a cooldown penalty
Plasma cutters eat more plasma when recharging and have slightly shorter range.
Mining MOD sphere mode no longer instamines, and now just has an extremely high mining speed.
Goldgrubs can now tunnel extremely fast and spawn much more frequently than before. Goldgrub burrowing can be interrupted by dealing damage to them.
Goldgrubs no longer reflect non-bomb/energy shots.
AOE mining methods now have a 10/25% chance to not mine siderite/shale unless it has ore inside of it.
Lavaland generation has been rewritten. The caves should be much more wilder.

title: [I **NOT** ded] Heart Eater only works with sentient beings' hearts (+heart ripping).
author: Y0SH1M4S73R

changes.text: Wizards with the Heart Eater perk are only invigorated by the hearts of sentient beings.

To facilitate the taking of hearts from sentient beings, the Heart Eater perk lets you tear the heart out of the chest of an incapacitated or dead being by targeting their chest with an empty hand in combat mode.

title: Arcmining: Chemical Boosting
author: ArcaneMusic

changes.text: The boulder smelter and refinery may now take a plumbing input (Closely examine to see the full list) to boost the mineral output of processed boulders.
Boulder refinery machines will produce a new chemical, industrial waste, which must be managed, dispersed, or it will eventually overflow if too much exists in the same container.
The smelter and refinery now produce less mining points per unit than before, but the quantity of points are now better scaled to the quantity processed. 50% more ores means 50% more points.
The amount of points generated per ore within boulders is now a separate variable, not a percentage of the base value. This means some ores are better/worse for generating mining points as a result.
Completing wave defense will award 200 more points across all ore vent tiers, 700/1200/1700 for small/medium/large vents.
